plugin.name: Charamel Embed (VuppetMaster JS-API)
plugin.description: Virtual character driven via the embedded VuppetMaster JavaScript API (vm.speak). Distinct from charamel-ws, which drives a Charamel-hosted page via the timeline-JSON protocol.

required.name: port
required.description: HTTP + WebSocket port serving the character page

required.name: sceneflowVar
required.description: SceneFlow variable set true when the character page connects (WebSocket handshake; fires before the 3D model has loaded)

required.name: characterReady
required.description: SceneFlow variable set true when the character model is fully loaded and audio is unlocked (the real 'ready to interact' signal)

required.name: characterSpeaking
required.description: SceneFlow variable true while the character is speaking

required.name: sceneflowTurnUtteranceVar
required.description: SceneFlow variable receiving the current utterance text

optional.name: certificate
optional.description: Path to SSL certificate (reserved; plain WS used when absent)

optional.name: browser
optional.description: Browser to open: empty = OS default, 'chrome' = Google Chrome, other = path to executable

pluginSpecific.name: engineUrl
pluginSpecific.description: URL of the VuppetMaster engine bundle

pluginSpecific.name: autostart_browser
pluginSpecific.description: Auto-open the character page in a browser on plugin launch

pluginSpecific.name: browser_fullscreen
pluginSpecific.description: Start browser in full-screen mode (Chrome only)

commands.name: background
commands.summary: Set the page backdrop shown behind the transparent avatar
commands.description: Usable from a SceneFlow PlayAction ([Xenia background color='#1a2a6c']) or inline scene marker. Any CSS color string.

commands.name: emotion
commands.summary: Play a named emotion on the avatar (vm.setEmotion)
commands.description: Generic form: [Xenia emotion type='happy' intensity='0.8' hold='1500']. Convenience aliases exist for each type so [Xenia happy] also works. Types: happy, sad, angry, tear, disgust, surprise, smile, excited, fear, bored, relaxed.

params.name: type
params.description: Emotion type (IEmotionType): happy | sad | angry | tear | disgust | surprise | smile | excited | fear | bored | relaxed

params.name: hold
params.description: Sustain ms; omit for a sustained pose held until changed/cleared

commands.name: clearemotion
commands.summary: Release the current emotion back to the idle base mood

writes.description: Set true when the character page connects (before model load)
Set true when the character model is fully loaded and audio unlocked
True while the character is speaking
